lore.minecraft.lantern: A block that emits more light than a torch. It can be hung from the ceiling, hung on a wall, placed on the ground or equipped.
lore.minecraft.stonecutter: A workstation used to craft building blocks. The job site of Masons.
lore.minecraft.compass: An item that points to the world spawn point. Can be attached to a lodestone to point to it instead. Can be equipped to tell the current position, heading and biome.
lore.minecraft.clock: A tool that helps tell the time. Can be equipped to tell the current time and day, weather and moon phase.
lore.minecraft.totem_of_undying: An item that allows the player to cheat death when held or equipped. It's an uncommon find.
lore.minecraft.spyglass: A tool that can be used to see far into the distance. Can be equipped to gain additional functions.
lore.minecraft.ender_chest: A block that provides personal storage, allowing items placed inside to be accessed only by the user from any Ender Chest. Can be equipped. It's fragile.
lore.minecraft.arrow: An item that can be used as ammunition for ranged weapons and Dispensers. Can be equipped.
lore.minecraft.spectral_arrow: An item that can be shot by Bows, Crossbows, and Dispensers to make its target glow. Can be equipped.
lore.minecraft.tipped_arrow: An arrow that applies a status effect on hit. Ammunition for Bows, Crossbows, and Dispensers. Can be equipped.
lore.minecraft.recovery_compass: An item that points towards your last death point. Can be equipped to tell the exact position of the death point. It's an uncommon find.
lore.minecraft.elytra: An item that allows the user to glide when worn. Can be equipped to free up space for a chestplate. It's an epic find!
tag.c.shulker_boxes.description: A storage block that can retain its items even when broken. Can be equipped.
tag.c.elytra.description: An item that allows the user to glide when worn. Can be equipped to free up space for a chestplate. It's an epic find!
lore.auroraslanterns.amethyst_lantern: A block that emits more light than a torch and repels mobs in a large radius. It can be hung from the ceiling, hung on a wall, placed on the ground or equipped.
lore.auroraslanterns.redstone_lantern: A block that emits light like a redstone torch and emits a directional redstone signal. It can be hung from the ceiling, hung on a wall, placed on the ground or equipped.
lore.sereneseasons.calendar: A tool that tells the current season.
lore.sereneseasons.season_sensor: A block that emits a redstone signal depending on the current season.
lore.via_romana.charting_map: An item that can be used to create roads for fast travel.
lore.friendsandfoes.crab_claw: An item that can be used to brew potions that extend block reach.
lore.friendsandfoes.crab_egg: Can be placed down and eventually hatches a baby crab.
